findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext in the Lambda environment variables. These are readable by anyone with describe/read permissions on the Lambda function, a far wider audience than those who should have access to the credentials, and they are also committed to source control.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a deprecated Lambda runtime that no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption configuration for environment variables
findings.description: The Lambda function does not specify a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables, relying on default encryption which offers no explicit key management or access control over the secrets stored in the environment.
